correctness.rationale: After similarity normalization, monotonicity under triangle containment reduces the problem to corner triangles. For the exact quotient r=(h-xy)/P, every interior critical point has positive second derivative in direction (1,-1) because A P''<2P, so maxima lie on the boundary. Each of the four boundary families is optimized exactly, and their closed-form values compare in the required order for 0<h<=1. Scaling back yields the stated formula; the displayed isosceles triangle attains it. Finite verifier checks are supplemental.

value.rationale: The result gives the complete sharp aspect-ratio profile for the natural rectangular extension of a published extremal square problem. It identifies a nontrivial saddle mechanism and a change from a two-dimensional optimization to an exact boundary comparison. The square golden-ratio constant is recovered as one endpoint, while thin rectangles have a distinct asymptotic regime. This is a motivated structural extension rather than an arbitrary parameter substitution.
